briefdescription.para: Convenience alias for a reference-counted DynamicObject pointer.

detaileddescription.para: Used throughout the DAP layer to build JSON objects without manual reference counting. The underlying DynamicObject is heap-allocated and kept alive by the juce::var that wraps it.

briefdescription.para: DAP request handlers, deferred-event drains, and the main loop of the adapter.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the constructor that fills the command and stop dispatch tables, run(), the onXxx handlers for each DAP request, the drains that processDeferredEvents runs for each stop reason, the DAP event builders, and writeMessage. All stdout writes happen on the main thread.
